title: Sipakapa language
description: Mayan language spoken in western Guatemala
extract: Sipakapense  is a Mayan language, closely related to Kʼicheʼ spoken natively within indigenous Sipakapense communities in Western Guatemala. It is primarily based in the municipality of Sipacapa in the department of San Marcos.
